title_en: Guiding Case No. 220: Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Co., Ltd. and Shanghai XinMou New Technology Co., Ltd. v. Wang Mou Group Co., Ltd., Ningbo Wang Mou Technology Co., Ltd., et al. — dispute over infringement of technical secrets
ruling_gist_en:
1. Where the right holder provides evidence proving that the accused infringer has illegally obtained technical secrets such as complete product process flows and complete sets of production equipment information, and has actually produced identical products, the people's court may find that the accused infringer has used all the technical secrets, unless the accused infringer provides sufficient contrary evidence to rebut such finding.

2. Where the accused infringer constitutes intentional infringement of technical secrets, the people's court may calculate the amount of damages based on the sales profit of the relevant products of the accused infringer; if the sales profit is difficult to determine, it may calculate the amount of damages based on the sales price and sales profit margin of the right holder's relevant products multiplied by the sales volume of the accused infringer's relevant products.

full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 220

Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Co., Ltd. v. Wang Group Co., Ltd. and Ningbo Wang Technology Co., Ltd.
— dispute over infringement of technical secrets

(Discussed and adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, published on December 15, 2023)

**Keywords** Civil / Infringement of Technical Secrets / Use of All Technical Secrets / Intentional Infringement of Technical Secrets / Amount of Damages

**Ruling Gist**

1. Where the right holder provides evidence proving that the alleged infringer has unlawfully obtained the complete product manufacturing process, complete sets of production equipment materials, and other technical secrets and has actually produced identical products, the people's court may determine that the alleged infringer has used all the technical secrets, unless the alleged infringer provides sufficient evidence to the contrary to overturn this determination.
2. Where the alleged infringer has committed an intentional infringement of technical secrets, the people's court may calculate the amount of damages based on the profits from the sale of the relevant products of the alleged infringer; if the sales profit is difficult to determine, the amount of damages may be calculated based on the sales price and profit margin of the right holder's relevant products multiplied by the sales volume of the alleged infringer's relevant products.

**Basic Facts**

Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company) is one of the world's leading manufacturers of vanillin, possessing significant technological advantages. Shanghai XinMou New Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Shanghai XinMou Company) was established on November 5, 1999, with a business scope including technical services, technical consulting, technical development, technology transfer in the biological and chemical professional fields, as well as the development of new products. Starting in 2002, Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company jointly developed a new process for preparing vanillin using the glyoxylic acid method, including reaction processes such as condensation, neutralization, oxidation, and decarboxylation, as well as circulation processes for guaiacol, toluene, copper oxide, and ethanol. The technical secrets claimed by Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company comprise six secret points. The carriers of these technical secrets are 287 equipment drawings (including master drawings and component drawings) related to 58 non-standard pieces of equipment and 25 process piping and instrumentation diagrams (third edition). The *Technology Development Contract*, *Technology Transfer Contract*, and *Special Contract for Long-term Enterprise Cooperation* entered into between Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company all contain confidentiality clauses.

Fu Mougen started working at Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company in 1991 and served as Deputy Director of the Vanillin Workshop from 2008, primarily responsible for the maintenance and repair of vanillin production equipment. Since 2003, Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company had successively formulated documents such as the Document Control Procedure, Record Control Procedure, Food Safety, Quality and Environmental Management Manual, and Equipment/Facility Management Procedure. Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company provided training to its employees regarding its internal management regulations. Fu Mougen participated in management system training, environmental management system training, publicity and education training, and standard implementation training in 2007. On March 25, 2010, Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company formulated the *Archives and Information Management Security and Confidentiality System*. Starting in April 2010, Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company successively signed confidentiality agreements with its employees, specifying the scope of trade secrets and the confidentiality obligations of the employees. Fu Mougen refused to sign the confidentiality agreement, citing his intention to resign.

Wang Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Wang Group Company) was established on June 8, 1995, with a business scope including the research, development, and production of the food additive potassium sorbate, and the manufacturing and sale of chemical products (excluding hazardous chemicals). Wang Jun served as its supervisor. Ningbo Wang Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Wang Technology Company) was established on October 21, 2009, co-funded by Wang Jun and Wang Group Company, with Wang Jun serving as its legal representative. Ningbo Wang Flavor & Fragrance Co., Ltd. was established on November 20, 2015, with a capital contribution of RMB 80 million in kind from Wang Technology Company. Its business scope included the research, development, and production of practical flavors and fragrances (food additives), with vanillin as its main product. Wang Jun served as its legal representative. In 2017, Ningbo Wang Flavor & Fragrance Co., Ltd. changed its name to Moufu Lion Wang Spices (Ningbo) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Moufu Lion Wang Company).

Around the Spring Festival of 2010, Feng Mouyi, Fu Mougen, and Fei Mouliang began discussions and sought trading opportunities for vanillin production technology. On April 12 of the same year, the three went to Wang Group Company and discussed cooperation on vanillin production technology with Wang Jun. They signed the *Vanillin Technology Cooperation Agreement*, with Jiaxing ZhiMou Engineering Technology Consulting Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jiaxing ZhiMou Company) as Party A and the Vanillin Sub-factory of Wang Group Company as Party B. On the same day, Wang Group Company issued a RMB 1,000,000 bank draft to Jiaxing ZhiMou Company. After endorsement, Feng Mouyi cashed a RMB 1,000,000 check, from which he paid RMB 400,000 to Fu Mougen and RMB 240,000 to Fei Mouliang. Subsequently, Fu Mougen handed over a USB flash drive to Feng Mouyi, which contained technical materials such as 200 vanillin production equipment drawings, 14 process piping and instrumentation diagrams, and a list of main equipment. Feng Mouyi then transferred these to Wang Jun. On April 15 of the same year, Fu Mougen submitted his resignation to Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company. In May of the same year, Fu Mougen left Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and subsequently, along with Feng Mouyi and Fei Mouliang, began working in the vanillin workshop of Wang Technology Company. On March 15, 2011, the Ningbo Municipal Environmental Protection Bureau of Zhejiang Province approved the Environmental Impact Report for the vanillin production and other construction projects of Wang Technology Company, approving an annual vanillin production capacity of 5,000 tons. In June of the same year, Wang Technology Company began producing vanillin. Since its establishment, Moufu Lion Wang Company continuously used the vanillin production equipment transferred as a capital contribution in kind by Wang Technology Company to produce vanillin.

In 2018, Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company filed a lawsuit with the Zhejiang High People's Court, arguing that Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, Moufu Lion Wang Company, Fu Mougen, and Wang Jun had infringed upon their technical secrets related to vanillin.

**Judgment**

The Zhejiang High People's Court rendered Civil Judgment (2018) Zhe Min Chu No. 25 on April 24, 2020: 1. Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, Moufu Lion Wang Company, and Fu Mougen shall immediately cease the infringement of the technical secrets involved in the case, i.e., cease the acts of acquiring, disclosing, using, or allowing others to use the technical secrets recorded in the equipment drawings and process piping and instrumentation diagrams involved in the case through unfair means; the duration of such cessation shall persist until the involved technical secrets become publicly known. 2. Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, and Fu Mougen shall, within ten days from the effective date of this judgment, jointly and severally compensate Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company for economic losses of RMB 3,000,000 and reasonable legal costs of RMB 500,000, totaling RMB 3,500,000; Moufu Lion Wang Company shall bear joint and several liability for 7% of the above amount, i.e., RMB 245,000. 3. The other claims of Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company are rejected. Except for Wang Jun, all parties to this case were dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment and appealed to the Supreme People's Court.

The Supreme People's Court rendered Civil Judgment (2020) Zui Gao Fa Zhi Min Zhong No. 1667 on February 19, 2021: 1. Civil Judgment (2018) Zhe Min Chu No. 25 of the Zhejiang High People's Court is reversed. 2. Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, Moufu Lion Wang Company, Fu Mougen, and Wang Jun shall immediately cease the infringement of the technical secrets of Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company, i.e., cease the acts of acquiring, disclosing, using, or allowing others to use the technical secrets recorded in the equipment drawings and process piping and instrumentation diagrams involved in the case through unfair means; the duration of such cessation shall persist until the involved technical secrets become publicly known. 3. Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, Fu Mougen, and Wang Jun shall, within ten days from the effective date of this judgment, jointly and severally compensate Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company for economic losses of RMB 155,829,455.20 and reasonable legal costs of RMB 3,492,216, totaling RMB 159,321,671.20; Moufu Lion Wang Company shall bear joint and several liability for 7% of the above amount, i.e., RMB 11,152,516.98. 4. The other claims of Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company are rejected. 5. The appeals of Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, Moufu Lion Wang Company, and Fu Mougen are dismissed. After the second-instance judgment was pronounced, Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, Moufu Lion Wang Company, Fu Mougen, and Wang Jun, being dissatisfied, applied to the Supreme People's Court for retrial.

The Supreme People's Court rendered Civil Ruling (2021) Zui Gao Fa Min Shen No. 3890 on October 19, 2021: The applications for retrial of Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, Moufu Lion Wang Company, Fu Mougen, and Wang Jun are rejected.

**Reasoning**

The Supreme People's Court held that: Since the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, had actually manufactured vanillin products, they must necessarily possess the complete process flow and corresponding equipment for manufacturing vanillin products. The technical secrets claimed by Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company included six secret points, involving 287 equipment drawings for 58 non-standard pieces of equipment and 25 process piping and instrumentation diagrams. The carriers of the alleged infringing technical information were 200 equipment drawings and 14 process flow diagrams acquired by the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company. A comparison showed that 184 of these equipment drawings were identical to the equipment drawings in the involved technical secrets in terms of structural type, size, design parameters, manufacturing requirements, as well as equipment names and numbers, drawing numbers, and drafting units, involving a total of 40 non-standard pieces of equipment. The 14 process flow diagrams were identical to the process piping and instrumentation diagrams of Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company in equipment positions and connection relationships, material and medium connection relationships, control contents and parameters, and some drawings had identical drawing names, project names, and design units. Furthermore, the de-toluene condenser equipment drawing provided by Wang Technology Company to Zhejiang HangZhou Container Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as HangZhou Company) and the Oxidation Unit Oxidation Process Flow Diagram (Exhibit 15) attached to the Environmental Impact Report of Wang Technology Company, although not included in the drawings submitted by Feng Mouyi, fell within the scope of the involved technical secrets. Given that Wang Technology Company had already used these two drawings in equipment processing and environmental assessment applications, it could be determined that Wang Technology Company had acquired them. In this case, the carriers of the involved technical secrets were 287 equipment drawings and 25 process piping and instrumentation diagrams. The alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, unlawfully acquired 185 of these equipment drawings and 15 process flow diagrams. Considering that the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, could make targeted modifications after acquiring the drawings of the involved technical secrets, even though there were minor differences in 4 items compared to the corresponding technical information in the involved technical secrets, based on the specific circumstances of this infringement, it could be fully determined that these differences resulted from evasive or adaptive modifications made by the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, after acquiring the involved technical secrets. Therefore, it could be determined that these 4 items also constituted the use of the involved technical secrets. On this basis, it could be further determined that the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, had actually used all 185 equipment drawings and 15 process flow diagrams they had acquired. The specific reasoning is as follows: First, vanillin production equipment and process flow are typically complementary, and the production process and related devices are relatively definite and fixed. Since the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, had actually built a vanillin project production line and engaged in large-scale production, they must necessarily possess the complete process flow and corresponding equipment for manufacturing vanillin products. Second, the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, refused to provide valid evidence proving their own research, development, and experimentation of the complete process flow and corresponding equipment for vanillin products. Moreover, they set up the vanillin project production line and commenced actual production in a very short time. Wang Technology Company's vanillin production line took only about one year from launch to mass production. In comparison, the development of the involved technical secrets by Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company, from research to the completion of the production line, took at least four years. Third, the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, failed to submit valid evidence proving that they had conducted small-scale or pilot-scale tests on the alleged technical solutions and related equipment. Furthermore, they had unlawfully acquired the involved technical drawings, and Wang Technology Company had already used the unlawfully acquired equipment drawings and process flow diagrams in its Environmental Impact Report and in the process of purchasing equipment from HangZhou Company. Taking into account the characteristics of technical secret infringement cases and the actual circumstances of this case, combined with the fact that the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, did not submit valid contrary evidence, it could be determined that the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, had used all the technical secrets they had unlawfully acquired. Fourth, although the vanillin production process flow and corresponding equipment of Wang Group Company and Wang Technology Company differed slightly from the involved technical secrets in a few respects, they did not submit evidence proving that these differences resulted from their own technological research and development or from technological achievements obtained through other legitimate means. At the same time, existing evidence showed that the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, only began to set up factories to produce vanillin products after acquiring the involved technical secrets. That is, they could very well have made evasive or adaptive modifications to certain production processes or individual accessory devices against the backdrop of the acquired technical secrets. Such modification itself is one of the ways of actually using the involved technical secrets. In summary, it was determined that the involved technical secrets unlawfully acquired by the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, from Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company, namely the 185 equipment drawings and 15 process flow diagrams, had all been actually used.

Fu Mougen had worked at Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company for a long time, being responsible for equipment maintenance in the vanillin workshop, and thus had access to the involved technical secrets. On April 12, 2010, Feng Mouyi, Fu Mougen, and another person went to Wang Group Company to discuss cooperation on vanillin production technology with Wang Jun and quickly reached the *Vanillin Technology Cooperation Agreement*, which stipulated that Feng Mouyi, Fu Mougen, and others would contribute the new vanillin process technology as equity to the Vanillin Sub-factory of Wang Group Company. Fu Mougen received RMB 400,000 as consideration under this agreement and subsequently handed over the USB flash drive containing the involved technical secrets to Wang Jun through Feng Mouyi. After resigning from Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company, Fu Mougen immediately joined Wang Technology Company, taking charge of the construction of the vanillin production line. Wang Technology Company completed the construction of the vanillin production line in a very short time and commenced industrial production, fully utilizing the equipment drawings and process flow diagrams of Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company. The above facts were sufficient to prove that Fu Mougen committed the acts of acquiring and disclosing the involved technical secrets to Wang Group Company and Wang Technology Company and allowing them to use these technical secrets. Both Wang Group Company and Wang Technology Company are enterprises engaged in the production and sale of vanillin, having a direct competitive relationship with Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company. They should have been aware that Fu Mougen, as an employee of Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company, had no legitimate rights to the company's vanillin production equipment drawings and process flow diagrams. Nevertheless, Wang Group Company, by signing the *Vanillin Technology Cooperation Agreement* and paying compensation to Fu Mougen, Feng Mouyi, etc., directly acquired the involved technical secrets of Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and disclosed them to Wang Technology Company for use. Wang Technology Company employed Fu Mougen and used his unlawfully acquired technical secrets for production, subsequently disclosing and allowing Moufu Lion Wang Company to continue using the involved technical secrets through an equipment capital contribution. All these acts infringed upon the technical secrets of Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company and Shanghai XinMou Company. Since its establishment, Moufu Lion Wang Company continuously used the vanillin production line contributed as technical capital by Wang Technology Company, thus constituting an infringement of the involved technical secrets.

The alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, unlawfully acquired and continuously and substantially used the high-value involved technical secrets. Their means were malicious, and they had the intent to infringe. Their conduct impacted the global vanillin market. Furthermore, the alleged infringers, including Wang Group Company, engaged in conduct such as obstructing evidence and lacking credibility in litigation. Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, Moufu Lion Wang Company, and Fu Mougen refused to comply with the effective interim measure order of the court of first instance. Based on these facts, the court, according to law, decided to calculate the amount of damages for infringement in this case based on sales profit. Since Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, and Moufu Lion Wang Company refused to submit account books and materials related to the infringing acts in this case, the court could not directly calculate the sales profit based on their actual sales data. Considering that the sales price and profit margin of Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company's vanillin product could serve as a reference for determining the relevant sales price and profit margin of Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, and Moufu Lion Wang Company, in order to severely punish malicious infringement of technical secrets and fully protect the legitimate interests of the right holder of technical secrets, the people's court decided to calculate the amount of damages in this case based on the sales profit margin of Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company's vanillin product during the period from 2011 to 2017. That is, the compensation was calculated by multiplying the production volume of vanillin produced and sold by Wang Group Company, Wang Technology Company, and Moufu Lion Wang Company from 2011 to 2017 by the sales price and profit margin of Jiaxing ZhongMou Chemical Company's vanillin product.

**Relevant Laws**

1. Article 1168 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China (The *Tort Liability Law of the People's Republic of China*, effective July 1, 2010, Article 8 applies to this case).
2. Articles 9 and 17 of the *Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China* (2019 Amendment) (The *Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China*, revised in 2017, Articles 9 and 17 applies to this case).
